lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The 90-minute meeting took place Thursday, days after Stellantis confirmed it was selling the idled Brampton Assembly Plant to Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer Roshel, ending plans to retool the facility for production of the next-generation Jeep Compass, The Canadian Press reports.
At least three killed and more than 20 injured in Russian strikes on Ukraine, The Associated Press reports.
Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy, BBC News reports.

Microsoft said progress is being made in bringing its popular workplace software back online as a global outage enters its second day, disrupting business communications, police emergency calls, court operations and AI tools, The Associated Press reports.
Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer for majority leader, NBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.

rows: CBS News
